title: Dr Munshi's Diary
subtitle: A Mysterious Diary and Razor-Sharp Observation
summary: When Feluda, the master detective, and his companions stumble upon a peculiar diary, their sharp wit and powers of observation are put to the test. Amid lively banter and subtle clues, secrets begin to surface, drawing the trio into a puzzle that only Feluda can unravel. Dive into this captivating adventure where every detail matters—can you keep up with Feluda's legendary mind?
